about_the_game:
BEFORE AVIUM,

we had colonized the Solar System, making our once estranged planets part of our new empire. But war followed us through space and time. 

DURING AVIUM,

cutting-edge cybernetics, super-power drugs, the loss of thousands of years of history, and the power feud between rivaling corporations plunged Avium, cyber-capital of the planet, into the age before a Revolution: chaos. Despite the aid of high-tech gadgets and sparse allies across the jungles, wasteland, and metropolis of Avium, all hope seemed to be lost. But you prevailed against tyranny, betrayal, and otherworldly phenomena at the cost of a new power vacuum.

IN VALKYRIE & DIEZEL

and in the aftermath of Guise's collapse, you, Sarah, and Nicodemus worked alongside GAMMA to restore Derek back to life and began setting Avium on a course toward peace and prosperity, but even then, a new more deadly force of evil was biding his time, looming far beyond the horizon, waiting to end humanity's reign...

MANA troops know him as Project Zodiac, aka Jericho. Every cutting-edge gadget and drug we possess is because of him—the top secret experimentations on his body and mind. Captain Dianna and company know everything there is to know about the megalomaniac and have imprisoned the menace on L.O.S.T., the orbital prison habitat, far from the reaches of Earth:

Little did you know during your previous conquests, you made an unexpected visit to L.O.S.T.: 

You unknowingly contributed to the stages of his release:

And now, in the Epic Conclusion, JERICHO'S AWAKENING,

Jericho turns his sights upon Avium, outfitted with the most advanced War-Suit known to exist: The Zodiac, capable of granting him all Psychokinetic abilities and the means to destroy not only the city, but the entire planet. He fights to return to an ancient and powerful relic from his past. If he reaches it, he dooms us all...

  • Take part in the hottest gaming experience in Avium known as "Shadow Lord" set in the ancient lands of Feudal Japan! "Shadow Lord" is all the rage these days for sword arcade enthusiasts! Test your mettle and your metal (sword) against your robotic enemies that have invaded the ancient lands of Teikoku and rescue the princess!

  • Pay a visit to Lower Avium's finest Heaven n' Hell Club as an esteemed patron and chill with other club-goers, "where Fleshers and Cogs can dance free from the worries of Avium"!

  • And use everything at your disposal to bring Jericho down before he can use what he claims to be "The Source" against humanity, to uncover the truth about him and how his tale is uncannily interwoven with your story!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700 CPU 3.20GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Install to SSD for quicker loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 3950X - Ryzen 9 3rd Gen 16-Core 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Install to SSD for quicker loading times
